related.title: Heidelberg Speedmaster 印刷機
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付模穴流道體積表、材料帳與多穴取捨。；教學單模質量上限 40 g，四穴通過、八穴失敗；不可只看每件成本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver cavity/runner volumes, material balance and multicavity tradeoff.; At a teaching 40 g shot limit, four cavities pass and eight fail; unit cost is not the sole criterion.
related.difference: 把印刷同步時間誤差換成紙面套準位移。
related.differenceEn: Convert synchronization timing error into sheet registration displacement.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: m=ρ(NVc+Vr)，產品與流道須一起計入每模質量。；教學密度 1.05 g/cm³，每件 5 cm³、4 模穴、總流道 4 cm³。；m=1.05×(4×5+4)=25.2 g，其中產品為 21 g。
恆速紙面上，套準位移 e=vΔt；不同方向誤差需分開。；教學等效紙速 500 mm/s，時間偏差 0.00010 s。；e=500×0.00010=0.050 mm=50 μm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: m=ρ(NVc+Vr); shot mass includes both product and runners.; Teaching density 1.05 g/cm³, 5 cm³ per part, four cavities and 4 cm³ runners.; m=1.05×(4×5+4)=25.2 g, of which product mass is 21 g.
At constant sheet speed, registration error e=vΔt; cross-direction error is separate.; Teaching equivalent sheet speed 500 mm/s and timing offset 0.00010 s.; e=500×0.00010=0.050 mm=50 μm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 切削刀具幾何與磨耗
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付模穴流道體積表、材料帳與多穴取捨。；教學單模質量上限 40 g，四穴通過、八穴失敗；不可只看每件成本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver cavity/runner volumes, material balance and multicavity tradeoff.; At a teaching 40 g shot limit, four cavities pass and eight fail; unit cost is not the sole criterion.
related.difference: 用教學 Taylor 關係量化速度改變的壽命敏感性，不把效率只等同速度。
related.differenceEn: Quantify speed–life sensitivity using a teaching Taylor relationship, rather than equating efficiency with speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: m=ρ(NVc+Vr)，產品與流道須一起計入每模質量。；教學密度 1.05 g/cm³，每件 5 cm³、4 模穴、總流道 4 cm³。；m=1.05×(4×5+4)=25.2 g，其中產品為 21 g。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: m=ρ(NVc+Vr); shot mass includes both product and runners.; Teaching density 1.05 g/cm³, 5 cm³ per part, four cavities and 4 cm³ runners.; m=1.05×(4×5+4)=25.2 g, of which product mass is 21 g.
VT^n=C; at fixed material conditions T2=T1(V1/V2)^(1/n).; Teaching T1=60 min, n=0.25 and V2/V1=1.25, without specifying a real cutting speed.; T2=60/(1.25^4)=24.576 min.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
